example.t: He abandoned his car in the snow.
example.zh: 他把车丢在了雪里。

example.t: Plants absorb water through their roots.
example.zh: 植物通过根部吸收水分。

example.t: There is now abundant scientific evidence that regular exercise improves mental health.
example.zh: 现在有大量科学证据表明，经常锻炼能改善心理健康。

example.t: She managed to accomplish all her goals before the end of the year.
example.zh: 她在年底前成功实现了所有目标。

example.t: Citizens demanded greater accountability from officials who spent vast public sums with little oversight.
example.zh: 民众要求那些在几无监督下动用巨额公款的官员承担更多责任。

example.t: Her report was accurate in every detail.
example.zh: 她的报告在每个细节上都准确无误。

example.t: She achieved her goal after years of study.
example.zh: 经过多年学习，她实现了自己的目标。

example.t: The surprise acquittal of the mayor shocked the public and angered many local voters.
example.zh: 市长出人意料地被判无罪，令公众震惊，也激怒了许多当地选民。

example.t: He felt acute pain in his chest and was rushed to the hospital immediately.
example.zh: 他感到胸口剧烈疼痛，被立刻送往医院。

meaning_zh: 坚决的；固执的；不动摇的

example.t: The board remained adamant that no further concessions would be offered to the union.
example.zh: 董事会坚决表示，不会再向工会作出任何让步。

example.t: Children adapt quickly to new schools.
example.zh: 孩子们能很快适应新学校。

meaning_zh: 举出；援引（作为证据或理由）

example.t: The lawyer adduced several documents to show that the contract had never been signed.
example.zh: 律师举出几份文件，以证明该合同从未签署过。

example.t: The room was adequate for two guests.
example.zh: 这个房间对两位客人来说够用了。

example.t: Many scientists advocate stricter limits on carbon emissions to slow the pace of global warming.
example.zh: 许多科学家主张更严格地限制碳排放，以减缓全球变暖的速度。

example.t: Swimming and running are both excellent forms of aerobic exercise for a strong heart.
example.zh: 游泳和跑步都是对强健心脏极佳的有氧运动形式。

example.t: Noise can affect your ability to concentrate.
example.zh: 噪音会影响你的注意力。

example.t: She signed a sworn affidavit describing exactly what she had witnessed on that night.
example.zh: 她签署了一份宣誓书，详细描述了那晚她所目睹的一切。

example.t: Affluent families spend far more on private tutoring than poorer ones do.
example.zh: 富裕家庭在私人辅导上的花费远多于贫困家庭。

example.t: The plan was finally accepted, albeit with several important changes to it.
example.zh: 该计划最终被接受了，尽管做了几处重要修改。

example.t: The search engine uses a complex algorithm to rank pages according to their relevance and popularity.
example.zh: 这个搜索引擎使用复杂的算法，根据相关性和受欢迎程度对网页进行排序。

example.t: His clever alibi finally collapsed when security footage showed him near the crime scene.
example.zh: 当监控录像显示他出现在犯罪现场附近时，他精巧的不在场证明终于崩溃。

example.t: The report alleges that senior managers knowingly concealed the losses from their own investors.
example.zh: 报告指称，几位高管明知亏损却向自己的投资者隐瞒。

example.t: In his speech he alluded to the scandal without ever mentioning any names directly.
example.zh: 演讲中他暗指那桩丑闻，却始终没有直接点出任何人的名字。

example.t: We need an alternative to this expensive plan.
example.zh: 我们需要一个替代这个昂贵方案的办法。

example.t: Her decision to donate the entire prize showed a rare altruism that moved everyone present.
example.zh: 她把整笔奖金全部捐出的决定展现出罕见的利他精神，令在场所有人动容。

meaning_zh: 歧义；含糊不清；模棱两可

example.t: The contract's ambiguity allowed both parties to claim that they had interpreted it correctly.
example.zh: 合同的含糊不清使双方都能声称自己的理解是正确的。

example.t: His answer was so ambiguous that nobody really knew what he meant.
example.zh: 他的回答如此含糊，以致没有人真正知道他想表达什么。

example.t: The government declared a general amnesty, releasing hundreds of political prisoners before the holiday.
example.zh: 政府宣布大赦，在节日前释放了数百名政治犯。

example.t: The teacher used an analogy with running water to explain how electricity works.
example.zh: 老师用流水的类比来解释电是如何工作的。

example.t: Scientists analyse the data carefully.
example.zh: 科学家们仔细分析这些数据。

example.t: The scientists could not explain the anomaly in the temperature data from that year.
example.zh: 科学家们无法解释那一年温度数据中的异常现象。

example.t: The revolution had its antecedents in the economic troubles of the previous decade.
example.zh: 这场革命的前因在于前十年间的经济困境。

example.t: The body produces a specific antibody to fight each new virus that it meets.
example.zh: 身体会产生一种特定的抗体，来对抗它遇到的每一种新病毒。

example.t: We anticipate that prices will rise sharply over the next few months.
example.zh: 我们预计未来几个月价格将大幅上涨。

meaning_zh: 冷漠；无动于衷；漠不关心

example.t: After years of failed reforms, a deep apathy toward politics spread among the weary citizens.
example.zh: 多年改革失败后，疲惫的民众中弥漫着对政治的深深冷漠。

example.t: It soon became apparent that he was lying.
example.zh: 很快就能看出他在说谎。

example.t: Conceding to every demand may appease the protesters today but will encourage further unrest.
example.zh: 对每一项要求都做出让步或许今天能安抚抗议者，却会助长进一步的动荡。

example.t: We tried a new approach to the problem.
example.zh: 我们对这个问题尝试了新方法。

example.t: Jeans are not appropriate for a formal dinner.
example.zh: 牛仔裤不适合正式晚宴。

example.t: Pollution from local farms has damaged aquatic life in rivers across the entire region.
example.zh: 来自当地农场的污染损害了整个地区河流中的水生生物。

example.t: The new rules seemed completely arbitrary and were very hard to justify.
example.zh: 这些新规定似乎完全武断，很难证明其合理性。

example.t: Rather than go to court, the two firms settled the dispute through private arbitration.
example.zh: 两家公司没有上法庭，而是通过私下仲裁解决了争端。

example.t: The team endured an arduous journey across the desert before reaching the remote village.
example.zh: 队伍历经艰辛穿越沙漠，才抵达那座偏远的村庄。

example.t: Few crops can survive in such an arid region without constant artificial irrigation at all.
example.zh: 在如此干旱的地区，若没有持续的人工灌溉，几乎没有作物能存活。

example.t: He missed the last bus; as a result, he had to walk home.
example.zh: 他错过了末班车；结果，他不得不步行回家。

example.t: Police are still trying to ascertain the exact cause of the terrible accident.
example.zh: 警方仍在努力查明这起严重事故的确切原因。

example.t: Historians ascribe the sudden collapse of the empire to a combination of plague and famine.
example.zh: 历史学家把该帝国的突然崩溃归因于瘟疫与饥荒的共同作用。

example.t: Cost is only one aspect of the problem that we must consider.
example.zh: 成本只是我们必须考虑的问题的一个方面。

example.t: The report makes a bold assertion without offering any supporting evidence at all.
example.zh: 报告提出了一个大胆的断言，却完全没有提供任何支持性证据。

example.t: Teachers assess students' progress each term.
example.zh: 老师每学期评估学生的进步。

example.t: Nothing the doctor said could assuage the parents' deep anxiety about the risky operation.
example.zh: 医生说什么都无法缓解父母对这台高风险手术的深切焦虑。

example.t: Do not assume that everyone agrees with you.
example.zh: 不要以为每个人都同意你。

example.t: The terrified family fled the war and applied for asylum in a neighbouring neutral country.
example.zh: 惊恐的一家人逃离战火，在邻国申请庇护。

example.t: He finally achieved success at the expense of his health and family.
example.zh: 他最终以牺牲健康和家庭为代价换来了成功。

example.t: A thick layer of cloud attenuated the sunlight, leaving the valley unusually cool and dim.
example.zh: 厚厚的一层云削弱了阳光，使山谷异常阴凉昏暗。

example.t: Her positive attitude impressed the interviewer.
example.zh: 她积极的态度给面试官留下了深刻印象。

example.t: The monks lived an austere life, owning almost nothing beyond the robes they wore.
example.zh: 僧侣们过着极为简朴的生活，除了身上的袍子几乎一无所有。

example.t: Years of austerity forced the city to close libraries and cut public services.
example.zh: 多年的紧缩政策迫使该市关闭图书馆并削减公共服务。

example.t: Under a strict autocracy, independent newspapers can never criticize the government without facing harsh punishment.
example.zh: 在严格的专制统治下，独立报纸一旦批评政府就难逃严厉惩罚。

example.t: Patients greatly value autonomy, so doctors should explain every option before asking them to decide.
example.zh: 病人十分看重自主权，因此医生在让他们决定前应解释每个选择。

example.t: It is a basic axiom of economics that people respond to incentives in predictable ways.
example.zh: 经济学的一条基本公理是：人们会以可预测的方式对激励作出反应。

example.t: His speech was full of banal remarks that everyone in the audience had heard before.
example.zh: 他的演讲满是陈词滥调，在场的每个人都早已听过。

example.t: Please bear in mind that the final deadline cannot be extended again.
example.zh: 请记住，最终截止日期不能再延长了。

example.t: Regular exercise has many health benefits.
example.zh: 经常锻炼对健康有很多好处。

example.t: The benevolent old landlord often quietly reduced the rent for families struggling to pay.
example.zh: 那位仁慈的老房东常常悄悄为付不起房租的家庭减租。

example.t: The scan showed that the growth was benign and required no immediate further treatment.
example.zh: 扫描显示这个肿块是良性的，不需要进一步治疗。

example.t: The total cost of the repairs was far beyond what we had expected.
example.zh: 维修的总费用远远超出了我们的预期。

example.t: The survey results may contain bias because only volunteers took part in it.
example.zh: 由于只有自愿者参与，调查结果可能存在偏差。

example.t: Protecting tropical forests is essential because they support most of the planet's remaining biodiversity.
example.zh: 保护热带森林至关重要，因为它们维系着地球上大部分残存的生物多样性。

example.t: Without new investment, the economic outlook for the region remained distinctly bleak over the next decade.
example.zh: 若无新的投资，该地区未来十年的经济前景依然十分黯淡。

example.t: The government hopes these measures will bolster confidence in an economy still recovering from recession.
example.zh: 政府希望这些措施能增强人们对一个仍在从衰退中复苏的经济的信心。

example.t: Sharing that confidential data with outsiders was a clear breach of the signed contract.
example.zh: 把那份保密数据泄露给外部人员，明显违反了已签署的合同。

example.t: Small businesses complain that bureaucracy makes it hard to obtain a licence.
example.zh: 小企业抱怨官僚程序使他们难以获得许可证。

example.t: Learning a foreign language well is by no means an easy task.
example.zh: 学好一门外语绝不是一件容易的事。

example.t: Technicians calibrate the instruments every month to ensure that the readings stay highly accurate.
example.zh: 技术人员每月校准仪器，以确保读数保持高度准确。

example.t: She was refreshingly candid about her own early mistakes during the painfully difficult interview.
example.zh: 在极其艰难的采访中，她坦率得令人耳目一新地谈了自己早年的错误。

example.t: Reducing our carbon footprint means changing how we travel, eat, and heat our homes.
example.zh: 减少我们的碳足迹意味着改变出行、饮食和为房屋供暖的方式。

example.t: Eating less salt and exercising more can greatly reduce the risk of cardiovascular disease.
example.zh: 少吃盐、多锻炼可以大大降低患心血管疾病的风险。

example.t: Enzymes in our cells catalyse the chemical reactions that keep the whole body functioning properly every day.
example.zh: 我们细胞中的酶催化着维持整个身体每天正常运转的化学反应。

example.t: A rise in global temperatures could have catastrophic consequences for many low-lying island nations.
example.zh: 全球气温上升可能会给许多低洼岛国带来灾难性的后果。

example.t: Writing the novel served as a catharsis after years of unspoken grief and quiet anger.
example.zh: 这部小说成为多年郁积的悲伤与愤怒的一种宣泄。

meaning_zh: 警告；附带条件；限制性说明

example.t: The author adds an important caveat: the findings apply only to adults under thirty.
example.zh: 作者加了一个重要的附带说明：这些发现仅适用于三十岁以下的成年人。

example.t: The committee voted to censure the minister for misleading parliament about the secret deal.
example.zh: 委员会表决通过，谴责这位大臣在秘密协议一事上误导议会。

example.t: Learning a language is a real challenge.
example.zh: 学一门语言是个真正的挑战。

example.t: The coach publicly chastised the players for their careless mistakes in the second half.
example.zh: 教练当众严厉批评球员下半场的粗心失误。

example.t: Millions of people live with chronic conditions that require daily medication and regular check-ups.
example.zh: 数百万人患有慢性病，需要每日服药并定期检查。

example.t: Some wealthy individuals use offshore accounts to circumvent the tax laws of their own country.
example.zh: 一些富人利用离岸账户规避本国的税法。

example.t: The rebels held clandestine meetings in a cellar to avoid detection by the police.
example.zh: 反叛者在地下室秘密集会，以免被警方发现。

example.t: Several small parties formed a fragile coalition in order to pass the annual budget.
example.zh: 几个小党结成脆弱的联盟，以便通过年度预算。

example.t: The confession was obtained by sheer coercion and was therefore thrown out of court.
example.zh: 那份供词是靠纯粹的胁迫取得的，因此被法庭排除。

meaning_zh: 有说服力的；令人信服的

example.t: She presented a cogent case for reform that even her critics found difficult to dismiss.
example.zh: 她提出了一个关于改革的有力论证，连她的批评者都难以驳倒。

example.t: Sleep deprivation impairs cognition, making it harder to concentrate, remember, and solve complex problems.
example.zh: 睡眠不足会损害认知，使人更难集中注意力、记忆和解决问题。

example.t: Learning a second language may significantly improve cognitive skills such as memory and attention.
example.zh: 学习第二语言可能显著提升记忆力和注意力等认知能力。

example.t: A good essay presents a coherent argument supported by relevant and reliable evidence.
example.zh: 一篇好文章会提出一个连贯的论点，并辅以相关而可靠的证据。

example.t: Shared festivals help strengthen social cohesion in a rapidly changing urban neighbourhood.
example.zh: 共同的节日有助于在快速变化的社区中增强社会凝聚力。

example.t: The researchers followed the same cohort of children for over twenty years.
example.zh: 研究人员对同一批儿童进行了二十多年的跟踪研究。

example.t: Coffee is one of the most heavily traded commodities in the world.
example.zh: 咖啡是世界上最主要的大宗交易商品之一。

example.t: The whole community came to the festival.
example.zh: 整个社区都来参加节日活动。

meaning_zh: 令人信服的；引人入胜的

example.t: She made a compelling case for investing in public transport rather than building more roads.
example.zh: 她提出了一个令人信服的理由，主张投资公共交通而非修建更多道路。

example.t: She is a highly competent manager who never once missed a deadline.
example.zh: 她是一位非常能干的经理，从未错过任何一次截止日期。

example.t: The team spent months compiling data from hundreds of separate field surveys.
example.zh: 团队花了数月时间汇编来自数百次独立实地调查的数据。

example.t: The human brain is extremely complex.
example.zh: 人脑极其复杂。

example.t: It is hard to comprehend why he made such a strange decision.
example.zh: 很难理解他为什么做出如此奇怪的决定。

example.t: Secondary education is compulsory in most countries until the age of sixteen.
example.zh: 在大多数国家，中等教育在十六岁前是义务教育。

meaning_zh: 承认（属实）；让步；勉强同意

example.t: Even the minister's fiercest critics concede that the reform has significantly reduced waiting times.
example.zh: 就连这位大臣最激烈的批评者也承认，这项改革已显著缩短了等候时间。

example.t: The concept is simple but hard to explain.
example.zh: 这个概念很简单，却很难解释。

example.t: The study concluded that sleep improves memory.
example.zh: 该研究得出结论：睡眠能改善记忆力。

example.t: World leaders condemned the attack as a completely cowardly act against defenceless innocent civilians.
example.zh: 各国领导人谴责这次袭击是懦夫行径，针对手无寸铁的平民。

example.t: Critics argue that the report conflates two very different problems and therefore offers no real solution.
example.zh: 批评者认为，该报告把两个截然不同的问题混为一谈，因此并未给出真正的解决办法。

example.t: Schools often reward strict conformity, quietly discouraging students from questioning rules or thinking independently.
example.zh: 学校往往奖励严格的从众行为，暗中打击学生质疑规则或独立思考。

example.t: The city introduced a congestion charge to reduce traffic in the centre.
example.zh: 该市引入了拥堵费以减少市中心的交通流量。

example.t: Without firm evidence, any explanation of this strange event is pure conjecture.
example.zh: 没有确凿的证据，对这一离奇事件的任何解释都纯属猜测。

example.t: After hours of debate the committee finally reached a consensus on the proposal.
example.zh: 经过数小时辩论，委员会终于就该提案达成了共识。

example.t: Poor planning had serious consequences.
example.zh: 计划不周带来了严重后果。

example.t: Wildlife conservation depends on funding as much as it does on steady public support.
example.zh: 野生动物保护既依赖资金，也同样依赖公众的持续支持。

example.t: Her parents are quite conservative about how late she may stay out.
example.zh: 她父母对她可以在外面待到多晚相当保守。

example.t: The project took a considerable amount of time.
example.zh: 这个项目花费了相当多的时间。

example.t: The firm hopes to consolidate its position in the market before foreign rivals enter the country.
example.zh: 该公司希望在外国竞争对手进入本国市场之前巩固其市场地位。

example.t: Her bright red coat made her conspicuous in the crowd of people dressed in grey.
example.zh: 她鲜红的外套让她在清一色灰衣的人群中格外显眼。

example.t: The MP visited every remote village in her rural constituency before the general election.
example.zh: 大选前，这位议员走访了她农村选区的每一个偏远村庄。

example.t: The judge construed the vague clause as favouring the tenant rather than the landlord.
example.zh: 法官把这条含糊的条款解释为有利于租客而非房东。

example.t: This machine consumes too much electricity.
example.zh: 这台机器耗电太多。

example.t: Measles is highly contagious, so unvaccinated children are usually kept away from other pupils.
example.zh: 麻疹传染性极强，因此未接种疫苗的孩子通常会被要求远离其他同学。

example.t: Industrial waste can contaminate nearby rivers and make the water unsafe for local residents.
example.zh: 工业废料会污染附近的河流，使水对当地居民来说不宜饮用。

example.t: Climate policy remains today one of the most contentious issues in contemporary global politics.
example.zh: 气候政策至今仍是当代全球政治中最具争议的问题之一。

example.t: The meaning of this phrase is entirely contextual and depends on the situation.
example.zh: 这个短语的含义完全取决于语境，要视情况而定。

example.t: The witness's second statement clearly contradicts everything that she said last week.
example.zh: 证人的第二份陈述明显与她上周所说的一切相矛盾。

example.t: Everyone contributed ideas to the discussion.
example.zh: 每个人都为讨论贡献了想法。

example.t: Words alone cannot convey how grateful I am for your generous help.
example.zh: 单凭言语无法表达我对你慷慨帮助的感激之情。

example.t: She took copious notes during the lecture and later typed them all up neatly.
example.zh: 讲座期间她记了大量笔记，之后又把它们工整地打了出来。

example.t: Researchers found that income levels correlate strongly with access to higher education.
example.zh: 研究者发现，收入水平与接受高等教育的机会密切相关。

example.t: Two independent witnesses corroborate the detailed account given by the main defendant.
example.zh: 两名独立证人的证词印证了主要被告的详细陈述。

example.t: The theory is only credible if it can be tested against real evidence.
example.zh: 只有当这一理论能对照真实证据加以检验时，它才是可信的。

example.t: Price is not the only criterion for choosing a good reliable laptop.
example.zh: 价格并不是选择一台好而可靠笔记本电脑的唯一标准。

example.t: The article presents a detailed critique of the government's recent economic policy.
example.zh: 这篇文章对政府近期的经济政策提出了详细的批评。

example.t: Water is crucial for all living things.
example.zh: 水对所有生物都至关重要。

example.t: He sent me a cryptic text message that I could not interpret without more context.
example.zh: 他发来一条隐晦的短信，没有更多背景我根本无法解读。

example.t: The official inquiry found the manager culpable for ignoring repeated and serious safety warnings.
example.zh: 官方调查认定该经理无视反复而严重的安全警告，应负罪责。

example.t: The cumulative effect of small daily savings can be surprisingly large over time.
example.zh: 每天一点点储蓄的累积效果，时间一长可能大得惊人。

example.t: The school added coding and financial literacy to its curriculum last year.
example.zh: 这所学校去年将编程和理财知识加入了课程。

example.t: A cursory glance at the report revealed several obvious errors in the final figures.
example.zh: 粗略扫一眼报告，就发现最终数字里有好几处明显的错误。

example.t: After a bitter divorce, the court granted her sole custody of both young children.
example.zh: 经历了一场痛苦的离婚后，法院把两个年幼孩子的单独监护权判给了她。

example.t: The article debunks several widely held myths about how the human memory actually works.
example.zh: 这篇文章揭穿了几个关于人类记忆如何运作的流行误解。

example.t: The whole elaborate scheme was built on deceit, and it finally collapsed in court.
example.zh: 整个精心设计的计划建立在欺骗之上，最终在法庭上土崩瓦解。

example.t: The government decided to decentralise power and give more authority to regions.
example.zh: 政府决定下放权力，赋予各地区更多自主权。

example.t: Sales declined sharply last winter.
example.zh: 去年冬天销售额急剧下降。

example.t: From these clues the detective could deduce exactly how the theft had happened.
example.zh: 侦探从这些线索可以准确推断出盗窃是如何发生的。

example.t: Deductive reasoning moves from a general principle towards a specific and certain conclusion.
example.zh: 演绎推理从一般原理出发，得出具体而确定的结论。

example.t: The council deemed the old building unsafe and ordered it to be closed immediately.
example.zh: 市议会认定这栋旧楼不安全，下令立即关闭。

example.t: The defendant denied every charge and insisted that he had been elsewhere that night.
example.zh: 被告否认了所有指控，坚称那晚他人在别处。

example.t: Deforestation in the Amazon has destroyed the homes of countless rare species over the decades.
example.zh: 数十年来，亚马孙地区的森林砍伐毁掉了无数珍稀物种的家园。

example.t: With a few deft movements, the surgeon closed the wound and stepped away from the table.
example.zh: 外科医生几个灵巧的动作就缝合了伤口，随即退离手术台。

example.t: Arthritis is a degenerative condition that gradually damages the body's joints over many years.
example.zh: 关节炎是一种退行性疾病，会在多年间逐渐损害人体的关节。

example.t: Plastic bags dumped into the sea take hundreds of years to degrade completely, harming wildlife.
example.zh: 被倒入海里的塑料袋需要数百年才能完全降解，还会危害野生动物。

example.t: The opening chapter carefully delineates the main themes that the book will explore.
example.zh: 开篇一章仔细界定了全书将要探讨的主要主题。

example.t: He clung to the delusion that his business would recover without any real change.
example.zh: 他抱着错觉不放，以为生意不做任何实质改变也能好转。

example.t: There is growing demand for clean energy.
example.zh: 对清洁能源的需求日益增长。

example.t: His unusually calm demeanor in the crisis reassured the staff and steadied everyone's nerves.
example.zh: 他在危机中异常镇定的举止让员工安心，也稳住了所有人的情绪。

example.t: Rapid demographic change has left many local schools without enough young pupils.
example.zh: 快速的人口结构变化使许多学校缺少足够的年轻学生。

example.t: The teacher demonstrated the experiment twice.
example.zh: 老师演示了两次这个实验。

example.t: Politicians should not openly denigrate the achievements of honest scientists who disagree with them.
example.zh: 政客不应公开贬低那些与自己意见相左的诚实科学家所取得的成就。

example.t: Human rights groups were quick to denounce the new law as a threat to basic freedoms.
example.zh: 人权组织迅速谴责这项新法律是对基本自由的威胁。

example.t: The painting depicts a quiet village beside a wide and gentle river.
example.zh: 这幅画描绘了一个宽阔平缓的河流旁的宁静村庄。

example.t: The rapid depletion of fish stocks threatens the livelihood of coastal communities all over the world.
example.zh: 鱼类种群的迅速枯竭威胁着全世界沿海社区的生计。

example.t: Teachers deplore the fact that many students rely entirely on software to write essays.
example.zh: 老师们强烈不满的是，许多学生完全依赖软件来写论文。

example.t: The government decided to deploy extra medical staff to the worst-hit rural regions immediately.
example.zh: 政府决定立即向受灾最严重的农村地区调配更多医务人员。

example.t: His colleagues derided the proposal as unrealistic, yet it eventually proved quite remarkably successful.
example.zh: 同事们嘲笑这个提案不切实际，但它最终却极为成功。

example.t: Much of our knowledge about the universe derives from careful observation of light.
example.zh: 我们对宇宙的许多认识都源自对光的细致观测。

example.t: Despite the heavy rain, the outdoor football match went ahead as planned.
example.zh: 尽管下着大雨，这场户外足球赛还是按计划进行了。

meaning_zh: 贬低；减损（与 from 连用）

example.t: A few minor errors certainly detract from the overall quality of this otherwise excellent paper.
example.zh: 几处小错确实损害了这篇本来很优秀的论文的整体质量。

example.t: Excessive screen time can be seriously detrimental to the eyesight of very young children.
example.zh: 过多的屏幕时间对幼儿的视力可能十分有害。

example.t: The company developed a new app.
example.zh: 这家公司开发了一款新应用。

example.t: Any deviation from the standard procedure must be reported to the supervisor.
example.zh: 任何偏离标准程序的做法都必须向主管报告。

example.t: Doctors ordered a series of diagnostic tests to find the cause of her fever.
example.zh: 医生安排了一系列诊断性检查，以查明她发烧的原因。

example.t: The simple dichotomy between good and evil rarely captures the moral complexity of real decisions.
example.zh: 善与恶的简单二分法很少能体现真实决定的道德复杂性。

example.t: Making small dietary changes can greatly improve your long-term health over the coming years.
example.zh: 在饮食上做些小改变，就能在未来几年里大大改善你的长期健康。

example.t: Working parents often face a serious dilemma between career and family time.
example.zh: 在职父母常常面临事业与家庭时间之间的严重两难困境。

example.t: The influence of the old market gradually diminished over the past decade.
example.zh: 过去十年里，这个旧市场的影响力逐渐减弱。

example.t: Patient and quiet diplomacy finally persuaded the two neighbours to sign a lasting peace.
example.zh: 耐心而低调的外交终于说服两个邻国签署了持久和平协议。

example.t: The charity warned that millions faced dire consequences unless food aid arrived very soon.
example.zh: 该慈善机构警告，若非食物援助很快抵达，数百万人将面临严重后果。

example.t: From the back of the hall I could barely discern the lecturer's faint voice.
example.zh: 坐在大厅后排，我几乎听不清讲师微弱的声音。

example.t: A discerning reader will notice the subtle shift in the author's tone halfway through.
example.zh: 有眼光的读者会注意到作者语气在中途发生的微妙变化。

example.t: The topic has dominated public discourse for much of the past decade or so.
example.zh: 这个议题在过去十年左右的时间里一直主导着公共讨论。

example.t: The leaked emails were intended to discredit the scientists who had published the study.
example.zh: 泄露的邮件意在败坏那些发表了该研究的科学家的名声。

example.t: There is a clear discrepancy between the official figures and our own data.
example.zh: 官方数字与我们自己的数据之间存在明显的不一致。

example.t: The data can be divided into several discrete categories for easier analysis.
example.zh: 为了便于分析，这些数据可以分成几个彼此分离的类别。

example.t: The law bans discrimination against workers on the grounds of age or gender.
example.zh: 法律禁止以年龄或性别为由歧视劳动者。

example.t: The report highlights the wide disparity in income between urban and rural households.
example.zh: 该报告凸显了城乡家庭之间收入的巨大差距。

example.t: Few historians now seriously dispute the claim that the treaty deepened the coming conflict.
example.zh: 如今很少有历史学家认真质疑这一说法：该条约加深了即将到来的冲突。

example.t: The internet allows scientific findings to be disseminated far more quickly than before.
example.zh: 互联网使科学发现能比以往更快地传播开来。

example.t: Any open dissent from the official line was quickly punished by the party leadership.
example.zh: 任何对官方路线公开表达的异议，都会被党的领导层迅速惩罚。

example.t: There are two distinct types of soil here.
example.zh: 这里有两种截然不同的土壤。

example.t: The media can easily distort the findings of a scientific study by over-simplifying.
example.zh: 媒体很容易通过过度简化而歪曲一项科学研究的发现。

example.t: Loud music can easily distract students while they are trying to study.
example.zh: 吵闹的音乐很容易让学生在试图学习时分心。

example.t: The city is home to people from many diverse cultural and religious backgrounds.
example.zh: 这座城市是许多来自不同文化和宗教背景的人们的家园。

example.t: The island is trying to diversify its economy beyond tourism and fishing.
example.zh: 该岛正努力使其经济在旅游业和渔业之外实现多元化。

example.t: The official refused to divulge any details about the closed meeting to curious reporters.
example.zh: 这位官员拒绝向好奇的记者透露那场闭门会议的任何细节。

meaning_zh: 武断的；教条的；固执己见的

example.t: His dogmatic refusal to consider alternative explanations made genuine discussion almost impossible among his colleagues.
example.zh: 他固执地拒绝考虑其他解释，使同事之间几乎无法进行真正的讨论。

example.t: The volcano had been dormant for centuries, so nobody expected it to erupt again.
example.zh: 这座火山已休眠数百年，因此没人料到它会再次喷发。

example.t: A long drought left the poor farmers with almost nothing to harvest that autumn.
example.zh: 一场长期干旱让贫穷的农民那年秋天几乎颗粒无收。

meaning_zh: 可疑的；半信半疑的；靠不住的

example.t: Many economists remain dubious about the forecast, given how rapidly conditions have changed recently.
example.zh: 鉴于形势近期变化如此之快，许多经济学家对这一预测仍持怀疑态度。

example.t: His shameless duplicity became obvious when he promised two rivals the very same job.
example.zh: 当他向两位对手许诺同一个职位时，他无耻的两面派作风便暴露无遗。

example.t: Tourism plays a key role in the economy.
example.zh: 旅游业在经济中起着关键作用。

example.t: A single invasive species can damage the whole delicate ecosystem of a small island.
example.zh: 单一的外来入侵物种就能破坏一个小岛整个脆弱的生态系统。

example.t: The new system is far more efficient.
example.zh: 新系统效率高得多。

example.t: The factory was heavily fined for dumping untreated effluent into the nearby river last year.
example.zh: 这家工厂因去年向附近河流排放未经处理的废水而被重罚。

example.t: An angry electorate decisively punished the ruling party for suddenly raising taxes so sharply.
example.zh: 愤怒的选民果断地惩罚了突然大幅加税的执政党。

example.t: The questionnaire was carefully designed to elicit honest responses from reluctant participants.
example.zh: 问卷经过精心设计，以从不太情愿的参与者那里引出诚实的回答。

example.t: Her eloquent defence of the proposal convinced even the most sceptical members of the board.
example.zh: 她对提案雄辩的辩护，说服了董事会中最持怀疑态度的成员。

example.t: The lecture aimed to elucidate the complex relationship between inflation and unemployment for first-year students.
example.zh: 这场讲座旨在为大一学生阐明通货膨胀与失业之间的复杂关系。

meaning_zh: 难以捉摸的；难以找到的

example.t: Despite years of research, a complete cure for the disease remains elusive to scientists.
example.zh: 尽管研究了多年，这种疾病的彻底治愈方法对科学家而言仍难以企及。

example.t: The government imposed a strict trade embargo to pressure the regime into releasing political prisoners.
example.zh: 政府实施严格的贸易禁运，以施压该政权释放政治犯。

example.t: Thousands of skilled workers emigrate each year in search of better wages.
example.zh: 每年都有数以千计的技术工人为寻求更高工资而移居国外。

example.t: Several eminent economists were recently invited to advise the government on its fiscal policy.
example.zh: 几位著名经济学家近日受邀就财政政策为政府提供建议。

example.t: The report measures the emission of greenhouse gases from power plants nationwide each year.
example.zh: 该报告每年衡量全国发电厂的温室气体排放量。

example.t: Good doctors listen carefully and show genuine empathy for the fears of their patients.
example.zh: 好医生会仔细倾听，并对病人的恐惧表现出真诚的同理心。

example.t: The course puts emphasis on speaking skills.
example.zh: 这门课强调口语能力。

example.t: The claim is supported by strong empirical evidence gathered over a decade of fieldwork.
example.zh: 这一主张得到了十年田野调查所获得的强有力实证证据的支持。

example.t: The final sentence encapsulates the entire argument in a way that readers easily remember.
example.zh: 最后一句以读者容易记住的方式概括了整个论证。

example.t: The survey encompasses a wide range of opinions from every social and age group.
example.zh: 这项调查涵盖了来自各个社会和年龄群体的广泛意见。

example.t: Banks encrypt sensitive data so that hackers cannot read it if it is stolen.
example.zh: 银行对敏感数据加密，这样即使数据被盗，黑客也无法读取。

example.t: The tiger is now an endangered species, with only a few thousand left in the wild.
example.zh: 老虎如今是濒危物种，野外仅存几千只。

example.t: Several famous athletes agreed to endorse the new popular sports drink in television advertisements.
example.zh: 几位著名运动员同意在电视广告中为这款新的热门运动饮料代言。

example.t: The small town endured years of hardship before the economy finally improved.
example.zh: 这个小镇在最终经济好转前经受了多年的困苦。

example.t: Regular practice can greatly enhance your confidence when you speak in public.
example.zh: 经常练习能大大增强你当众演讲的自信。

example.t: Many voters resent what they see as an entitlement culture among the unemployed.
example.zh: 许多选民反感他们所认为的失业者中的福利依赖文化。

example.t: A young entrepreneur turned a small bike shop into a nationwide delivery firm.
example.zh: 一位年轻创业者把一家小自行车店发展成全国性配送公司。

example.t: The essay enumerates the main causes of urban poverty in a clear order.
example.zh: 这篇文章按清晰的顺序列举了城市贫困的主要原因。

example.t: We must protect the environment for future generations.
example.zh: 我们必须为后代保护环境。

example.t: Online fame is often ephemeral, fading within days once public attention suddenly moves elsewhere.
example.zh: 网络名声往往转瞬即逝，公众注意力一旦转移，几天内便消散。

example.t: The government acted quickly to control the epidemic before it spread to the capital.
example.zh: 政府迅速采取行动，在疫情蔓延到首都之前控制住了它。

example.t: A fair tax system should be equitable, asking more from those who earn far more.
example.zh: 公平的税制应该是公正的，向收入高得多的人征收更多。

meaning_zh: 模棱两可的；含糊的；可作多种解释的

example.t: The minister gave an equivocal answer that left journalists unsure of the government's real position.
example.zh: 那位大臣给出了模棱两可的回答，让记者们搞不清政府的真实立场。

example.t: Heavy rain has caused serious soil erosion on the hillsides around the village over the years.
example.zh: 多年来，大雨在村庄周围的山坡上造成了严重的水土流失。

example.t: His erratic driving alarmed the passengers, who asked him to pull over at once.
example.zh: 他时快时慢的驾驶让乘客惊慌，他们要求他立刻靠边停车。

example.t: The author deliberately eschews jargon so that ordinary readers can follow the argument easily.
example.zh: 作者刻意避免使用行话，以便普通读者能轻松理解其论证。

example.t: The party openly claims to espouse equality, yet its policies favour the wealthiest citizens.
example.zh: 该党公开宣称拥护平等，但其政策却偏袒最富有的公民。

example.t: Good sleep is essential for good health.
example.zh: 良好睡眠对健康必不可少。

example.t: The college was established in 1890.
example.zh: 这所学院建于1890年。

example.t: The city is home to more than fifty ethnic groups and languages.
example.zh: 这座城市拥有五十多个民族群体和语言。

example.t: The phrase 'letting staff go' is a euphemism for dismissing large numbers of employees.
example.zh: “让员工离开”这个说法是解雇大量员工的一种委婉表达。

example.t: The team's stunning victory produced a euphoria that lasted for several days and nights.
example.zh: 队伍惊人的胜利带来一阵狂喜，持续了好几个日夜。

example.t: There is no evidence to support his claim.
example.zh: 没有证据支持他的说法。

example.t: The old photograph evoked memories of happy summers spent at her grandmother's seaside cottage.
example.zh: 这张旧照片唤起了她在祖母海边小屋度过的那些快乐夏日回忆。

example.t: Cutting public spending during a recession would only exacerbate the problems facing ordinary families.
example.zh: 在衰退期间削减公共开支只会加剧普通家庭面临的问题。

example.t: The job demands exacting standards of accuracy that very few candidates can consistently meet.
example.zh: 这份工作要求极高的准确度标准，很少有应聘者能始终达到。

example.t: This particular case perfectly exemplifies the wider trend towards remote and flexible working.
example.zh: 这一特定案例完美地体现了向远程灵活办公转变的更广泛趋势。

meaning_zh: 免除罪责；洗清…的嫌疑；开脱

example.t: New forensic evidence eventually exonerated the man who had spent a decade in prison.
example.zh: 新的法医证据最终洗清了那名在狱中度过十年的男子的罪名。

example.t: Tourists complained that hotels charged exorbitant prices during the peak holiday season along the coast.
example.zh: 游客抱怨沿海酒店在假期旺季收取高得离谱的房价。

example.t: The company plans to expand overseas.
example.zh: 公司计划向海外扩张。

example.t: Public expenditure on health has risen much faster than spending on defence.
example.zh: 公共卫生支出的增长速度远快于国防支出。

example.t: The teacher gave explicit instructions about how to write the final essay.
example.zh: 老师就如何撰写这篇期末论文给出了明确的指示。

example.t: The spread of the virus showed exponential growth in the first few weeks before measures were introduced.
example.zh: 在采取措施之前的头几周里，病毒的传播呈指数级增长。

example.t: The professor expounded his theory for an hour without ever referring to any notes.
example.zh: 教授讲了一个小时阐述他的理论，全程未看一眼笔记。

example.t: Many scientists warn that human activity is driving species to extinction at an alarming rate.
example.zh: 许多科学家警告说，人类活动正以惊人的速度将物种推向灭绝。

example.t: The editor removed all extraneous details, leaving a tight argument that was easy to follow.
example.zh: 编辑删去所有无关细节，留下一条清晰易懂、紧凑的论证。

meaning_zh: 推断；外推；由已知推知未知

example.t: It is risky to extrapolate long-term trends from data covering only a few recent years.
example.zh: 仅凭最近几年的数据就推断长期趋势是有风险的。

example.t: The witness had fabricated his entire story in order to protect the real culprit.
example.zh: 这名证人为保护真正的罪犯，完全编造了整段证词。

example.t: Cost is an important factor in our decision.
example.zh: 成本是我们决策的重要因素。

example.t: The belief that hard work always guarantees success is a fallacious assumption about modern society.
example.zh: 认为努力工作总能保证成功，是关于现代社会的一个错误假设。

example.t: It is a common fallacy that we use only ten percent of our brains.
example.zh: 认为我们只用了大脑百分之十是一个常见的错误观念。

example.t: He is fastidious about the arrangement of his desk and cannot work amid any clutter.
example.zh: 他对书桌的摆放极为讲究，身处杂乱之中就无法工作。

example.t: It is not financially feasible for us to build a new library.
example.zh: 对我们来说，新建一座图书馆在财务上并不可行。

example.t: Stealing a car is a serious felony, and he faced several years in prison.
example.zh: 偷车是严重的重罪，他因此面临数年监禁。

example.t: The fertile soil near the river allows farmers to harvest two crops each year.
example.zh: 河边肥沃的土壤让农民每年能收获两季作物。

example.t: Our working hours are quite flexible.
example.zh: 我们的工作时间相当灵活。

example.t: Prices of raw materials fluctuate constantly in response to changes in global supply.
example.zh: 原材料价格随全球供应的变化而不断波动。

example.t: Please focus on the main idea.
example.zh: 请把注意力集中在主要观点上。

example.t: The bank raised interest rates early in order to forestall a sharp rise in inflation.
example.zh: 该银行提前加息，以预先阻止通胀急剧上升。

meaning_zh: 强大的；艰巨的；令人敬畏的

example.t: Climbing the frozen peak in winter presented a formidable challenge even to experienced mountaineers.
example.zh: 冬季攀登这座冰封山峰，即使对经验丰富的登山者也是一项艰巨挑战。

example.t: Burning fossil fuels releases huge amounts of carbon dioxide into the atmosphere every year.
example.zh: 燃烧化石燃料每年向大气中释放大量二氧化碳。

example.t: The two systems are fundamentally different in the way that they work.
example.zh: 这两个系统在工作方式上有着根本的不同。

example.t: Arguing with him about the decision proved futile because he had already made up his mind.
example.zh: 跟他争论这个决定是徒劳的，因为他早已下定决心。

example.t: The shocking images galvanised the public into demanding immediate nationwide reform of the law.
example.zh: 那些触目惊心的画面激励公众行动起来，要求立即对法律进行全国性改革。

example.t: Wind farms generate clean electricity.
example.zh: 风电场产生清洁电力。

example.t: She showed genuine concern for the many students who were still struggling.
example.zh: 她对许多仍在挣扎的学生表现出真诚的关心。

example.t: Only comments germane to the discussion will be recorded in the official minutes of the meeting.
example.zh: 只有与讨论密切相关的评论才会被记入会议的正式纪要。

example.t: Globalisation has brought cheaper goods but also greater pressure on local producers.
example.zh: 全球化带来了更便宜的商品，但也给本地生产者带来更大压力。

example.t: Good governance requires transparency, accountability, and a genuine respect for the rule of law.
example.zh: 良好的治理需要透明、问责，以及对法治的真正尊重。

example.t: The weather gradually got warmer.
example.zh: 天气渐渐变暖了。

example.t: Few students could grasp the main idea of such an abstract article.
example.zh: 很少有学生能理解这篇如此抽象的文章的主旨。

example.t: Farmers grow tomatoes all year round in a large heated greenhouse near the village.
example.zh: 农民们在村子附近一座大型温室里全年种植西红柿。

example.t: Building roads through the forest destroys the natural habitat of many rare wild animals.
example.zh: 在森林中修路会破坏许多珍稀野生动物的自然栖息地。

example.t: The shelves were stocked in a haphazard way, so customers struggled to find anything.
example.zh: 货架上的东西摆放得杂乱无章，顾客找什么都费劲。

example.t: The survivors gave a harrowing account of the fire that destroyed their entire village.
example.zh: 幸存者讲述了那场烧毁整个村庄的大火，描述令人痛心。

example.t: The empire's enduring cultural hegemony shaped the language and customs of half the region.
example.zh: 该帝国持久的文化霸权塑造了这一地区一半的语言与习俗。

example.t: The road was flooded; hence, we had to take a longer route.
example.zh: 道路被水淹了；因此，我们不得不走一条更长的路线。

example.t: The condition is hereditary, so relatives of patients are advised to have regular tests.
example.zh: 这种病是遗传性的，因此建议患者的亲属定期检查。

example.t: Do not hesitate to ask me if you have any questions about the task.
example.zh: 如果你对这项任务有任何疑问，请不要犹豫，直接问我。

example.t: In a strict hierarchy, junior staff rarely challenge their senior managers openly.
example.zh: 在严格的等级制度中，下级员工很少公开质疑管理者。

example.t: The doctor favoured a holistic approach that considered both body and mind.
example.zh: 这位医生主张采取兼顾身心的整体方法。

example.t: Saying the delay was a catastrophe is pure hyperbole, since the goods arrived a day late.
example.zh: 说这次延误是一场灾难纯属夸张，因为货物只晚到了一天。

example.t: Doctors warn that untreated hypertension can eventually lead to a serious stroke or heart attack.
example.zh: 医生警告说，未治疗的高血压最终可能导致严重的中风或心脏病发作。

example.t: The politician's sheer hypocrisy disgusted voters once his shady private deals became public knowledge.
example.zh: 当这位政客见不得人的私下交易曝光后，他十足的虚伪令选民反感。

example.t: The experiment was designed to test whether the original hypothesis was truly correct.
example.zh: 该实验旨在检验最初的假设是否正确。

example.t: The party's ideology shaped almost every policy it introduced in the 1980s.
example.zh: 该党的意识形态影响了它在20世纪80年代推出的几乎每一项政策。

example.t: She kept her small flat immaculate, dusting every surface before guests could possibly arrive.
example.zh: 她把小公寓打理得一尘不染，在客人到来前擦拭了每一处表面。

example.t: Many immigrant families run small shops that keep the high street alive.
example.zh: 许多移民家庭经营的小商店让商业街保持活力。

example.t: A strong immune system helps the body fight off infections before they become serious.
example.zh: 强大的免疫系统能帮助身体在感染变得严重之前将其击退。

meaning_zh: 不可改变的；永恒不变的

example.t: Physicists once treated the speed of light as an immutable constant of the universe.
example.zh: 物理学家曾把光速视为宇宙中不可改变的常量。

example.t: Social media has a huge impact on teenagers.
example.zh: 社交媒体对青少年有巨大影响。

example.t: Judges are expected to remain impartial no matter how strongly they feel about a case.
example.zh: 无论对案件感受多么强烈，法官都应保持公正。

example.t: Her manners were impeccable throughout the formal dinner, impressing even the host's strict grandmother.
example.zh: 整个正式晚宴上她举止无可挑剔，连主人严厉的祖母也印象深刻。

example.t: Heavy snow and strong winds impeded the rescue teams' progress through the mountain pass.
example.zh: 大雪和强风阻碍了救援队穿越山口的进程。

example.t: He remained impervious to their harsh criticism and continued with his original, ambitious plan.
example.zh: 他对他们的严厉批评无动于衷，继续执行自己原定的大胆计划。

meaning_zh: 难以置信的；不合情理的

example.t: The witness gave an implausible excuse that no reasonable jury member could possibly believe.
example.zh: 证人给出的借口不合情理，任何有理智的陪审员都不会相信。

example.t: The author's criticism of the policy is implicit rather than stated in words.
example.zh: 作者对该政策的批评是含蓄的，而不是明说的。

example.t: His silence seemed to imply that he did not agree with us.
example.zh: 他的沉默似乎暗示他并不同意我们。

example.t: The government suddenly imposed new heavy taxes on imported cars last autumn.
example.zh: 政府去年秋天突然对进口汽车征收了新的重税。

example.t: The report unfairly imputes the city's housing crisis to immigrants rather than to policy failures.
example.zh: 该报告把该市的住房危机不公正地归咎于移民，而非政策失误。

example.t: In sharp contrast, the second group showed almost no improvement at all.
example.zh: 与之形成鲜明对比的是，第二组几乎没有表现出任何进步。

example.t: In terms of price, this model is clearly better than the other one.
example.zh: 就价格而言，这款机型明显比另一款更好。

example.t: Exercising regularly now will greatly benefit your health in the long run.
example.zh: 现在经常锻炼，从长远来看对你的健康有益。

example.t: Tax cuts provided a strong incentive for people to buy electric cars.
example.zh: 减税为人们购买电动汽车提供了强有力的激励。

example.t: The incidence of the disease has fallen sharply since the vaccine was introduced.
example.zh: 自疫苗引入以来，这种疾病的发病率已大幅下降。

example.t: Her incisive analysis of the data exposed flaws the previous researchers had completely overlooked.
example.zh: 她对数据的犀利分析，揭示了此前研究者完全忽略的漏洞。

meaning_zh: 不显眼的；不引人注意的

example.t: The spy chose an inconspicuous seat near the back of the crowded little café.
example.zh: 间谍在这家拥挤的小咖啡馆里挑了后排一个不显眼的位置。

meaning_zh: 现任的；在职的；有义务的

example.t: The incumbent mayor easily defeated her young rival in the crowded and bitter primary race.
example.zh: 在拥挤而激烈的初选中，现任市长轻松击败了年轻的对手。

meaning_zh: 不知疲倦的；坚持不懈的

example.t: The indefatigable volunteer spent every weekend for a decade cleaning the local polluted riverbank.
example.zh: 这位不知疲倦的志愿者十年间每个周末都在清理被污染的河岸。

meaning_zh: 起诉书；控告；（对制度的）控诉

example.t: The grand jury's lengthy indictment listed twelve separate criminal charges against the former official.
example.zh: 大陪审团冗长的起诉书列出了针对这名前官员的十二项独立刑事指控。

example.t: The museum works closely with indigenous communities to protect their ancient traditions.
example.zh: 博物馆与土著社区密切合作，保护他们的传统。

meaning_zh: 不可或缺的；必不可少的

example.t: A reliable dictionary is indispensable to anyone who wants to master a foreign language.
example.zh: 对任何想精通一门外语的人来说，一本可靠的词典不可或缺。

example.t: Each individual has different needs.
example.zh: 每个人都有不同的需求。

example.t: Inductive reasoning builds general rules from a large number of specific observations.
example.zh: 归纳推理从大量具体观察中概括出一般规律。

example.t: His inept handling of the complaint badly angered customers and damaged the shop's reputation.
example.zh: 他对投诉的笨拙处理激怒了顾客，也损害了店铺的声誉。

example.t: Widening inequality has become one of the most debated issues in politics.
example.zh: 不断扩大的不平等已成为政治中最受争议的问题之一。

example.t: Some conflict is inevitable when people work closely together for many years.
example.zh: 当人们多年来紧密合作时，一些冲突是不可避免的。

example.t: Readers must infer the writer's attitude from the choice of words used.
example.zh: 读者必须根据所用的措辞推断作者的态度。

example.t: Readers are expected to draw their own inference from the evidence presented in the text.
example.zh: 读者应当从文中提供的证据中自己得出结论。

example.t: The doctor prescribed a drug to reduce the inflammation around her badly injured knee.
example.zh: 医生开了一种药，以减轻她严重受伤的膝盖周围的炎症。

example.t: Rising inflation has made basic food and fuel unaffordable for many families.
example.zh: 不断上升的通货膨胀使许多家庭负担不起基本食物和燃料。

example.t: His teacher had a lasting influence on him.
example.zh: 他的老师对他产生了持久的影响。

example.t: The region needs massive investment in infrastructure such as roads, bridges and ports.
example.zh: 该地区需要在道路、桥梁和港口等基础设施上进行大规模投资。

example.t: There are inherent risks in relying on a single supplier for such critical components.
example.zh: 如此关键的部件只依赖单一供应商，本身就存在固有风险。

example.t: She inherited a small farm from her grandmother and moved back home.
example.zh: 她从祖母那里继承了一个小农场，并搬回了家乡。

example.t: Alcohol lowered his inhibitions, so he publicly said things he would otherwise never mention.
example.zh: 酒精降低了他的顾忌，于是他公开说出了平时绝不会提的事。

example.t: A community initiative has reduced litter on the local beach by more than half.
example.zh: 一项社区倡议使当地海滩的垃圾减少了一半以上。

example.t: The judge issued an injunction preventing the company from cutting down the ancient trees.
example.zh: 法官发布禁令，阻止该公司砍伐那些古树。

example.t: What seemed an innocuous remark at the meeting later triggered a serious bitter dispute.
example.zh: 会上那句看似无害的话，后来竟引发了一场严重的激烈争执。

example.t: Firms that fail to innovate quickly lose customers to more agile rivals.
example.zh: 未能迅速创新的公司会把顾客输给更灵活的竞争对手。

example.t: The insidious spread of online misinformation slowly eroded public trust in the mainstream media.
example.zh: 网络虚假信息暗中蔓延，逐渐侵蚀了公众对主流媒体的信任。

example.t: Her new book offers fresh insight into how children actually learn languages.
example.zh: 她的新书为儿童实际如何学习语言提供了全新见解。

example.t: Are you insinuating that I deliberately copied the idea from someone else's unpublished work?
example.zh: 你是在暗示我故意抄袭了别人未发表的作品吗？

example.t: Stress at work often causes insomnia, leaving people too tired to concentrate the next day.
example.zh: 工作压力常常导致失眠，让人第二天疲惫得无法集中注意力。

example.t: Her first instinct was to run, but she forced herself to stay and help.
example.zh: 她的第一反应是想跑，但她强迫自己留下来帮忙。

example.t: Universities are among the oldest institutions in continuous existence in modern Europe.
example.zh: 大学是欧洲持续存在最久的机构之一。

example.t: Critical thinking is an integral part of any serious programme of academic training.
example.zh: 批判性思维是任何严肃学术训练中不可或缺的一部分。

example.t: Schools should help immigrant children integrate into the local community very quickly.
example.zh: 学校应帮助移民儿童迅速融入当地社区。

example.t: People trusted the old judge because his personal integrity had never once been seriously questioned.
example.zh: 人们信任这位老法官，因为他的个人正直从未受到过严肃质疑。

example.t: The heat in the desert was so intense that we could hardly breathe.
example.zh: 沙漠中的酷热如此强烈，我们几乎无法呼吸。

example.t: Different readers may interpret the same short poem in completely different ways.
example.zh: 不同的读者可能对同一首短诗做出完全不同的解读。

example.t: Economists still disagree about how much government intervention a free market needs.
example.zh: 经济学家们仍不同意自由市场需要多少政府干预。

example.t: Poverty remains an intractable problem that decades of government policy have failed to solve.
example.zh: 贫困仍是个棘手难题，数十年的政府政策都未能解决。

example.t: The artisan spent months carving the intricate patterns that cover the entire wooden door.
example.zh: 工匠花了几个月雕刻覆盖整扇木门的繁复图案。

example.t: Curiosity is an intrinsic part of human nature, not something we are taught.
example.zh: 好奇心是人性中固有的一部分，而不是被教出来的。

example.t: Her advice proved invaluable when we had to negotiate the complicated legal contract alone.
example.zh: 当我们不得不独自谈那份复杂的法律合同时，她的建议极为宝贵。

example.t: The lawyer invoked an obscure nineteenth-century statute to defend her elderly client in court.
example.zh: 律师援引一条鲜为人知的十九世纪法规，在法庭上为年迈的当事人辩护。

meaning_zh: 不可撤销的；无法挽回的

example.t: Signing the document was an irrevocable step that would change her entire career forever.
example.zh: 签署这份文件是无法撤回的一步，将永远改变她的整个职业生涯。

example.t: Modern irrigation allows farmers to grow crops even in areas with very little rain.
example.zh: 现代灌溉让农民即使在降雨极少的地区也能种植作物。

example.t: The case fell outside the local court's jurisdiction and was quickly dismissed.
example.zh: 该案件不在法院管辖范围内，因此很快被驳回。

example.t: You must always justify your decision with clear evidence and sound reasoning.
example.zh: 你必须始终用清晰的证据和可靠的推理来证明你的决定是正当的。

example.t: Copying the manuscript by hand was a laborious process that took him three years.
example.zh: 手工抄写这份手稿是个费力的过程，花了他三年时间。

example.t: Cheap labour attracted foreign firms to build large factories along the coast.
example.zh: 廉价劳动力吸引外国公司在沿海建厂。

example.t: The team gave a lacklustre performance and lost the final match by three goals.
example.zh: 球队表现平平，最终以三球之差输掉了决赛。

example.t: Villagers lament the loss of the ancient forest that once sheltered them from storms.
example.zh: 村民们为失去这片曾为他们挡风遮雨的古老森林而痛惜。

example.t: New legislation requires all factories to reduce their carbon emissions by 2030.
example.zh: 新法规要求所有工厂在2030年前减少碳排放。

example.t: The protesters insisted that their demands were entirely legitimate and deserved a serious public response.
example.zh: 抗议者坚称他们的诉求完全正当，理应得到认真的公开回应。

meaning_zh: 有责任的；负有法律责任的；易于……的

example.t: The company still remains liable for any damage caused by its own faulty products.
example.zh: 公司仍须为其自身缺陷产品造成的任何损害承担责任。

example.t: Nearly all adults in the region are literate, yet few read books.
example.zh: 该地区几乎所有成年人都识字，但很少有人读书。

example.t: The dispute dragged on for years, and costly litigation eventually ruined both small firms.
example.zh: 这场纠纷拖了多年，昂贵的诉讼最终毁掉了两家小公司。

example.t: He pursued lofty ideals about education while ignoring the practical needs of his students.
example.zh: 他追求崇高的教育理想，却忽视了学生的实际需求。

example.t: A longitudinal study tracks the same participants across many years of their lives.
example.zh: 纵向研究会跨越多年跟踪同一批参与者。

meaning_zh: 清晰易懂的；头脑清醒的

example.t: The professor gave a lucid explanation of quantum mechanics that even beginners could follow.
example.zh: 教授对量子力学作了清晰透彻的讲解，连初学者也能听懂。

example.t: Translating engineering documents abroad proved a surprisingly lucrative sideline for the very young graduate.
example.zh: 在国外翻译工程文件，成了这名年轻毕业生收入颇丰的副业。

example.t: Spending a fortune on a single party struck everyone as a ludicrous waste of money.
example.zh: 在一场派对上花大笔钱，大家都觉得荒唐，纯属浪费。

example.t: Few people realise the true magnitude of the problem facing the planet.
example.zh: 很少有人意识到地球所面临问题的真正严重程度。

example.t: Ideas once considered radical are now firmly part of mainstream political life.
example.zh: 曾被视作激进的思想如今已成为主流政治生活的一部分。

example.t: It is hard to maintain a healthy diet.
example.zh: 保持健康饮食很难。

example.t: The majority of students passed the exam.
example.zh: 大多数学生通过了考试。

example.t: Doctors removed the malignant tumour before it could spread quickly to other vital organs.
example.zh: 医生赶在恶性肿瘤迅速扩散到其他重要器官之前将其切除。

example.t: The new mayor claimed a clear mandate to reform the city's public transport.
example.zh: 新市长声称获得了改革公共交通的明确授权。

example.t: His disappointment was manifest to everyone when the results were finally announced that afternoon.
example.zh: 那天下午结果终于公布时，他的失望众人一眼便知。

example.t: The new drug produced only a marginal improvement in patients' recovery rates.
example.zh: 这种新药对患者的康复率只带来了微小的改善。

example.t: Poor transport links have largely marginalised remote villages from the national economy.
example.zh: 交通不便使偏远村庄在很大程度上被排斥在全国经济之外。

example.t: The restaurant serves mediocre food at surprisingly high prices that suggest far better quality.
example.zh: 这家餐厅的食物平庸，价格却高得离谱，让人以为品质上乘。

example.t: A quiet melancholy settled over him as he walked through the empty old house.
example.zh: 当他走过空荡荡的老房子时，一种淡淡的忧郁笼罩了他。

example.t: He was merely trying to help you, so please do not blame him.
example.zh: 他只不过是想帮你，所以请不要责怪他。

example.t: Regular exercise can speed up your metabolism and help control your weight over time.
example.zh: 规律锻炼可以随着时间推移加快新陈代谢，并有助于控制体重。

example.t: The paper describes its research methodology in enough detail to be replicated.
example.zh: 该论文对其研究方法描述得足够详细，可供重复验证。

example.t: Her meticulous notes made it possible to reconstruct the experiment years after it ended.
example.zh: 她那极其细致的笔记使得在实验结束多年后仍能重建该实验。

example.t: Housing in the metropolitan area costs twice as much as in nearby towns.
example.zh: 大都市地区的住房价格是附近城镇的两倍。

example.t: Rural-to-urban migration has left many small villages with only elderly residents behind.
example.zh: 农村向城市的迁移使许多村庄只剩下老年人。

example.t: He warned that his silence might somehow be misconstrued as an admission of guilt.
example.zh: 他提醒说，自己的沉默或许会被误解为承认有罪。

example.t: Planting trees can significantly mitigate the effects of urban heat and improve local air quality.
example.zh: 植树能显著减轻城市热效应，并改善当地的空气质量。

example.t: Better education is often seen as a route to greater social mobility.
example.zh: 更好的教育常被视为通向更大社会流动性的途径。

example.t: The central bank tightened monetary policy in order to bring down rising prices.
example.zh: 央行收紧货币政策以压低不断上涨的物价。

example.t: The company held a near monopoly on rail freight for over a decade.
example.zh: 该公司在铁路货运上几乎垄断了十多年。

example.t: The unexpected pay rise did wonders for staff morale during an otherwise difficult year.
example.zh: 在原本艰难的一年里，意外的加薪极大地提振了员工士气。

example.t: The plan is far too expensive; moreover, it will take years to finish.
example.zh: 这个计划太昂贵了；而且，它需要数年才能完成。

example.t: Most of her day was filled with mundane tasks like filing, typing and answering emails.
example.zh: 她一天里多半是些单调的琐事，如归档、打字和回复邮件。

example.t: Municipal libraries offer free internet access to residents of every age group.
example.zh: 市立图书馆为各年龄段居民提供免费上网服务。

example.t: His relentless narcissism ensured that every conversation would eventually revolve around his own achievements.
example.zh: 他极度自恋，任何谈话最终都会绕回他自己的成就。

example.t: Many drivers neglect the basic checks that could prevent serious road accidents.
example.zh: 许多司机忽视了本可避免严重道路事故的基本检查。

example.t: The hospital was sued for gross negligence after failing to monitor the patient properly.
example.zh: 该医院因未能妥善监护病人而被以重大过失起诉。

example.t: The difference between the two groups was so small as to be negligible.
example.zh: 两组之间的差异小到可以忽略不计。

example.t: Unions will negotiate with management over pay and working hours next week.
example.zh: 工会将于下周与管理层就薪酬和工作时间进行谈判。

example.t: The task was extremely difficult; nevertheless, the team finished it on time.
example.zh: 这项任务极其困难；尽管如此，团队还是按时完成了。

example.t: Working from home has now become the norm in many modern companies.
example.zh: 在家工作如今已成为许多现代公司的常态。

example.t: Looking at the faded photographs filled her with nostalgia for her old childhood village.
example.zh: 看着褪色的照片，她心中满是对童年村庄的怀念。

example.t: The study challenges the common notion that longer schooling always improves exam results.
example.zh: 这项研究挑战了「受教育时间越长成绩越好」的普遍观念。

meaning_zh: 声名狼藉的；臭名昭著的

example.t: The city is notorious for its heavy traffic, especially during the morning rush hour.
example.zh: 这座城市以交通拥堵著称，尤其在早高峰时段。

example.t: The burning plastic gave off noxious fumes that made everyone in the room cough.
example.zh: 燃烧的塑料散发出有毒的烟雾，让屋里的每个人都咳嗽起来。

example.t: A good translation captures every nuance of the original text, including its unspoken assumptions.
example.zh: 好的译本会捕捉原文的每一处细微差别，包括其未言明的假设。

example.t: Good schools nurture curiosity in children rather than simply rewarding correct answers.
example.zh: 好学校培养孩子的好奇心，而不只是奖励正确答案。

example.t: Every essential nutrient the body needs daily can be found in a balanced diet.
example.zh: 身体每天所需的各种必需营养都能从均衡饮食中获得。

example.t: Childhood obesity has risen sharply since cheap fast food became widely available.
example.zh: 自廉价快餐普及以来，儿童肥胖率急剧上升。

meaning_zh: 使模糊；混淆；故意使…费解

example.t: The company's dense legal language seemed designed to obfuscate rather than clarify the terms.
example.zh: 该公司晦涩的法律措辞似乎意在混淆而非澄清条款。

example.t: Journalists should try to remain objective when reporting on controversial political events.
example.zh: 记者在报道有争议的政治事件时应努力保持客观。

example.t: Many jobs may become obsolete as machines take over tasks once done by hand.
example.zh: 随着机器接管曾是手工完成的活儿，许多工作可能会变得过时。

example.t: A lack of money remains the biggest obstacle to finishing this project.
example.zh: 资金短缺仍是完成这个项目的最大障碍。

example.t: Better long-term planning would have obviated the need for such expensive and disruptive emergency measures.
example.zh: 更好的长期规划本可消除此类昂贵且具破坏性的应急措施的必要性。

example.t: Books and old papers occupied almost every corner of his small study.
example.zh: 书籍和旧文件几乎占据了他小书房里的每个角落。

meaning_zh: 寡头政治；寡头统治集团

example.t: Critics argue that the country is really run by a wealthy oligarchy, not ordinary voters.
example.zh: 批评者认为，这个国家实际上由富有的寡头集团统治，而非普通选民。

example.t: He is not lazy at all; on the contrary, he works extremely hard.
example.zh: 他一点也不懒；恰恰相反，他工作极其努力。

example.t: The team worked hard to optimise the website so that it loads much faster.
example.zh: 团队努力优化网站，使其加载速度快得多。

example.t: A local ordinance bans smoking in all parks and public squares across the city.
example.zh: 一项地方条例禁止在全市所有公园和公共广场吸烟。

example.t: The policy was ostensibly designed to help small firms, yet it mainly benefited large corporations.
example.zh: 该政策表面上是为帮助小企业而制定的，但主要受益者却是大公司。

example.t: Their ostentatious display of wealth made the other guests feel quite uncomfortable all evening.
example.zh: 他们炫富的做派让其他宾客整晚都感到很不自在。

example.t: The manager quickly outlined her plan for expanding the company into three overseas markets.
example.zh: 经理简要概述了她把公司拓展到三个海外市场的计划。

example.t: It is difficult to overstate how deeply the invention changed everyday life in cities.
example.zh: 这项发明对城市日常生活的改变之深，怎么夸大都不为过。

example.t: The ozone layer protects life on Earth from harmful ultraviolet radiation from the sun.
example.zh: 臭氧层保护地球上的生命免受太阳有害紫外线的伤害。

meaning_zh: 大流行病；全球性流行病

example.t: A pandemic spreads across continents and affects far more people than a local outbreak.
example.zh: 大流行病会跨越各大洲传播，影响的人数远多于局部疫情。

example.t: The discovery caused a complete paradigm shift in the field of physics.
example.zh: 这一发现引发了物理学领域一次彻底的范式转变。

example.t: It is a curious paradox that the richest nations often report the highest levels of anxiety.
example.zh: 一个奇怪的悖论是，最富裕的国家往往报告出最高程度的焦虑。

example.t: The study was carried out within the strict parameters set by the ethics committee.
example.zh: 这项研究是在伦理委员会设定的严格界限内进行的。

example.t: Years of isolation had deepened his paranoia until he trusted absolutely no one around him.
example.zh: 多年的孤立加深了他的偏执，以至于他不信任身边的任何人。

meaning_zh: 党派性的；偏袒的；（名词）坚定支持者

example.t: The debate grew so partisan that neither side would even consider the other's evidence.
example.zh: 这场辩论变得如此党派化，以至双方都不愿考虑对方的证据。

example.t: A new pathogen can spread quickly through a crowded city before doctors recognise it.
example.zh: 新的病原体能在医生识别出来之前，迅速在拥挤的城市中传播。

example.t: Her research focuses on pedagogy and on how young children learn to read.
example.zh: 她的研究聚焦于教学法以及幼儿如何学习阅读。

example.t: Many retired workers live on a state pension that barely covers food and heating.
example.zh: 许多退休工人靠国家养老金生活，仅够支付食物和取暖。

example.t: Children often perceive the world quite differently from the way adults do.
example.zh: 孩子们对世界的看法常常与成年人大不相同。

example.t: Our perception of risk is often distorted by vivid news reports and personal experience.
example.zh: 我们对风险的感知常常被耸动的新闻报道和个人经历所扭曲。

example.t: Rural issues remain peripheral to most national election campaigns in big cities.
example.zh: 在大城市主导的全国竞选中，农村议题仍处于边缘地位。

meaning_zh: 有害的；恶性的；潜移默化地有害的

example.t: The pernicious influence of misinformation can quietly erode public trust in democratic institutions over time.
example.zh: 错误信息的恶劣影响会逐渐悄然侵蚀公众对民主制度的信任。

example.t: Travelling abroad gave her a fresh perspective on her own home culture.
example.zh: 出国旅行让她对自己的本土文化有了全新的视角。

example.t: She finally persuaded her parents to let her study art in Paris.
example.zh: 她终于说服父母让她去巴黎学艺术。

example.t: She asked several pertinent questions that the official report had failed to address.
example.zh: 她提出了几个切中要害的问题，而官方报告未能回应。

example.t: Corruption was so pervasive that even minor officials expected bribes for routine daily services.
example.zh: 腐败如此普遍，连基层官员办例行事务都索要贿赂。

example.t: Heavy use of pesticide has poisoned the soil and killed many beneficial insects over time.
example.zh: 大量使用农药毒害了土壤，并随着时间推移杀死了许多益虫。

example.t: Scientists still cannot fully explain this strange natural phenomenon in the desert.
example.zh: 科学家们仍然无法完全解释沙漠中这种奇怪的自然现象。

example.t: His severe phobia of heights prevented him from ever taking the company's glass lift.
example.zh: 他严重的恐高症使他从来不敢乘坐公司的玻璃电梯。

example.t: Fear produces clear physiological changes in the body, such as a faster heartbeat and breathing.
example.zh: 恐惧会在身体上引起明显的生理变化，比如心跳和呼吸加快。

example.t: Engineers struggled to pinpoint the exact cause of the repeated failures in the system.
example.zh: 工程师们苦苦寻找系统反复出现故障的确切原因。

example.t: In the trial, patients given a placebo reported fewer symptoms than the doctors had expected.
example.zh: 在试验中，服用安慰剂的病人报告的症状比医生预想的要少。

example.t: The plaintiff claimed that the hospital had ignored several clear warnings about the infection.
example.zh: 原告称医院忽视了关于该感染的数项明确警告。

example.t: The speech was full of comforting platitudes but contained no concrete proposal for reform.
example.zh: 这场演讲充满令人宽慰的陈词滥调，却没有提出任何具体的改革方案。

example.t: His explanation sounds plausible, but there is no evidence to support it.
example.zh: 他的解释听起来合理，但没有证据支持。

example.t: Genes play an important role in shaping a person's character and health.
example.zh: 基因在塑造一个人的性格和健康方面起着重要作用。

example.t: The referendum polarised the country along lines of age, region and education.
example.zh: 这次公投使全国在年龄、地区和受教育程度上形成两极分化。

example.t: The book is less a balanced study than a fierce polemic against the government's energy policy.
example.zh: 这本书与其说是一项持平的研究，不如说是对政府能源政策的猛烈抨击。

example.t: The main air pollutant in the city comes from old diesel vehicles and factories.
example.zh: 该市主要的空气污染物来自老旧的柴油车辆和工厂。

example.t: The sudden rise of populism pushed mainstream parties across Europe toward simpler, angrier slogans.
example.zh: 民粹主义的骤然兴起，促使欧洲各地主流政党转向更简单、更愤怒的口号。

meaning_zh: 假定；假设（作为前提提出）

example.t: The theory posits that early childhood experiences shape personality far more than genetics does.
example.zh: 该理论假定，童年早期的经历对性格的塑造远大于遗传的作用。

example.t: Scientists postulate the existence of dark matter to explain observed gravitational effects.
example.zh: 科学家假定暗物质存在，以解释观测到的引力效应。

example.t: This drug is extremely potent, so even a tiny dose can be very dangerous.
example.zh: 这种药药性极强，因此即使是很小的剂量也可能非常危险。

example.t: She is a potential leader of the team.
example.zh: 她可能是团队的领导者。

example.t: Millions of families still live in poverty despite a decade of rapid growth.
example.zh: 尽管经历了十年快速增长，数百万家庭仍生活在贫困之中。

example.t: The minister took a pragmatic view and accepted a smaller but achievable budget.
example.zh: 部长采取务实态度，接受了一个较小但可实现的预算。

example.t: After the local factory closed down, the family's financial position became very precarious indeed.
example.zh: 当地工厂关闭后，这家的经济状况变得极为岌岌可危。

example.t: The sudden rise in fuel prices precipitated a crisis that few analysts had anticipated.
example.zh: 燃油价格的突然上涨促成了一场几乎没有分析师预料到的危机。

example.t: The old train arrived at precisely eight o'clock every morning without fail.
example.zh: 这列旧火车每天早上都分秒不差地在八点整到达。

example.t: A lack of funding will preclude any expansion of the programme this academic year.
example.zh: 资金短缺将使该计划本学年无法扩大。

example.t: Experts predict that sea levels will continue to rise for many decades.
example.zh: 专家预测海平面将在未来数十年持续上升。

example.t: Farming remains the predominant form of employment in this rural mountain region.
example.zh: 在这个山区乡村地区，务农仍是最主要的就业形式。

example.t: Education is one of the most effective ways to reduce prejudice between groups.
example.zh: 教育是减少群体间偏见最有效的方式之一。

example.t: The whole argument rests on the premise that people always act rationally.
example.zh: 整个论证建立在人们总是理性行事这一前提之上。

example.t: We should preserve these ancient buildings for the benefit of future generations.
example.zh: 我们应该为了后代的利益保护这些古建筑。

meaning_zh: 冒失的；放肆的；自作主张的

example.t: It would be presumptuous of me to assume that everyone here shares my opinion.
example.zh: 我若假定在座各位都同意我的看法，那就太冒失了。

example.t: This belief was still prevalent among scientists in the early nineteenth century.
example.zh: 这种看法在十九世纪初的科学家当中仍然十分普遍。

example.t: My previous job was in a bank.
example.zh: 我上一份工作是在银行。

example.t: Honesty is a basic principle that guides all of his business decisions.
example.zh: 诚实是指导他所有商业决策的基本原则。

example.t: For most young families, health and safety are clearly the highest priority.
example.zh: 对大多数年轻家庭来说，健康和安全显然是头等大事。

example.t: Educational privilege is often passed quietly from one generation to the next.
example.zh: 教育特权往往悄无声息地代代相传。

example.t: Voters demanded complete financial probity from candidates who handled large amounts of public money.
example.zh: 选民要求那些经手大量公款的候选人做到完全廉洁。

example.t: All visitors must follow the correct safety procedure before entering the laboratory.
example.zh: 所有访客在进入实验室前都必须遵守正确的安全程序。

example.t: The war had a profound effect on the whole generation of writers.
example.zh: 那场战争对这一整代作家产生了深远的影响。

example.t: The doctor said the prognosis was good because the cancer had been found early.
example.zh: 医生说预后良好，因为癌症发现得早。

example.t: Bacteria can proliferate rapidly in warm, moist environments where food and moisture are plentiful all year round.
example.zh: 细菌在温暖潮湿、食物和水分全年充足的环境中能迅速增殖。

meaning_zh: 宣传（常含贬义）；政治宣传

example.t: Ruthless wartime propaganda painted the enemy as cruel monsters who deserved absolutely no mercy.
example.zh: 无情的战时宣传把敌人描绘成不配任何怜悯的残忍怪物。

example.t: A large proportion of the city population now regularly works from home.
example.zh: 这座城市很大一部分人口现在经常在家工作。

example.t: The prosecution presented compelling evidence that the chief accountant had deliberately falsified several records.
example.zh: 控方出示了有力证据，证明总会计师蓄意伪造了数份记录。

example.t: The port brought prosperity to a town that had lost its main industry.
example.zh: 这座港口给一个失去了主要产业的城镇带来了繁荣。

example.t: Delegates signed a protocol on cutting emissions after weeks of hard bargaining.
example.zh: 经过数周艰苦谈判，代表们签署了一份关于减排的议定书。

example.t: You may borrow my old car provided that you drive very carefully.
example.zh: 只要你开得非常小心，就可以借用我的旧车。

example.t: The law makes no provision for families who cannot afford private childcare.
example.zh: 法律没有为负担不起私立托育的家庭作出规定。

example.t: It would be prudent to save part of your monthly salary for unexpected medical bills.
example.zh: 把你月薪的一部分存起来，以备意外的医疗开支，是审慎的做法。

example.t: Psychologists believe that early experiences shape the human psyche far more than we admit.
example.zh: 心理学家认为，早期经历对人类心灵的塑造远超我们的承认。

example.t: The psychological effects of losing a job can last much longer than the financial ones.
example.zh: 失业带来的心理影响可能比经济影响持续得久得多。

example.t: The judge imposed heavy punitive damages to punish the firm for its deliberate deception.
example.zh: 法官判处高额惩罚性赔偿，以惩罚该公司蓄意的欺骗行为。

example.t: After graduation she decided to pursue a full-time career in medical research.
example.zh: 毕业后她决定从事医学研究的全职工作。

example.t: The study used qualitative interviews to explore how patients felt about treatment.
example.zh: 该研究采用定性访谈来探究患者对治疗的感受。

example.t: It is difficult to quantify the emotional benefits that music brings to listeners.
example.zh: 很难量化音乐给听众带来的情感益处。

example.t: Quantitative analysis revealed a strong statistical link between diet and heart disease.
example.zh: 定量分析揭示了饮食与心脏病之间很强的统计关联。

example.t: Quantum computers may one day solve complex problems that ordinary machines could never handle.
example.zh: 量子计算机也许有一天能解决普通机器永远无法处理的复杂问题。

example.t: The government set a strict quota on the number of foreign workers.
example.zh: 政府对海外劳工的数量设定了严格的配额。

example.t: He rarely speaks in public because he is afraid of making mistakes.
example.zh: 他很少在公众场合讲话，因为他害怕犯错。

example.t: The minister explained the rationale behind the decision to raise interest rates.
example.zh: 部长解释了提高利率这一决定背后的理由。

example.t: The spokesperson rose to rebut each accusation with carefully prepared figures and written evidence.
example.zh: 发言人起身，用精心准备的数据和书面证据逐一反驳每项指控。

example.t: I cannot recall exactly when we first met, but it was autumn.
example.zh: 我记不清我们第一次见面的确切时间，但那是秋天。

example.t: The economy slipped into recession and unemployment kept rising for almost three years.
example.zh: 经济陷入衰退，失业率持续上升了近三年。

example.t: It is difficult to reconcile the company's public promises with its actual environmental record.
example.zh: 很难把该公司的公开承诺与其实际的环境记录协调一致。

example.t: Her long reputation for moral rectitude made her the obvious choice to lead the inquiry.
example.zh: 她长期以品行端正著称，这使她成为领导此次调查的不二人选。

example.t: Progressive taxes are designed to redistribute wealth from the richest to the poorest.
example.zh: 累进税旨在把财富从最富者重新分配给最贫困者。

example.t: The victims had no real way to seek redress for the terrible losses they suffered.
example.zh: 受害者对于所遭受的惨重损失无从寻求补救。

example.t: We should reduce the amount of plastic we use.
example.zh: 我们应该减少塑料的使用量。

example.t: The government promised to hold a referendum on changing the voting system.
example.zh: 政府承诺就改革选举制度举行公投。

example.t: New evidence appeared to refute the theory that had dominated for centuries.
example.zh: 新证据似乎驳斥了统治了几个世纪之久的那个理论。

example.t: She asked several detailed questions regarding the new rules on sick leave.
example.zh: 她就病假新规提出了几个详细的问题。

example.t: The brutal regime jailed any journalist who dared to report openly on the protests.
example.zh: 这个残暴的政权把任何敢于公开报道抗议的记者都投入监狱。

example.t: Few countries regulate advertising aimed at young children as strictly as Sweden does.
example.zh: 很少有国家像瑞典那样严格管制针对幼儿的广告。

example.t: These recent findings reinforce the view that good sleep strongly affects memory.
example.zh: 这些新发现强化了良好睡眠对记忆有强烈影响这一观点。

example.t: The test was relatively easy for me.
example.zh: 这次考试对我来说相对容易。

example.t: He was reluctant to leave his old job for a higher salary.
example.zh: 他不愿意为更高的薪水而离开原来的工作。

example.t: She made remarkable progress in English during only six short months of study.
example.zh: 她仅在六个月的短暂学习期间，英语就取得了显著进步。

example.t: After months of treatment her cancer went into remission and she returned to work.
example.zh: 经过数月治疗，她的癌症进入缓解期，她也重返了工作岗位。

example.t: Investing in renewable energy could cut pollution and create millions of new green jobs.
example.zh: 投资可再生能源既能减少污染，又能创造数百万个新的绿色就业岗位。

meaning_zh: 正式放弃；声明放弃（权利、信仰）

example.t: He was forced to renounce his citizenship after being convicted of serious financial crimes.
example.zh: 他因被判严重金融犯罪而被迫放弃国籍。

example.t: The regime's brutal repression of free speech silenced journalists and terrified ordinary citizens alike.
example.zh: 该政权对言论自由的残酷镇压让记者噤声，也令普通民众惊恐不安。

example.t: The party leadership moved quickly to repudiate the remarks made by its own spokesperson.
example.zh: 该党领导层迅速否认并谴责了其自身发言人的言论。

example.t: The small restaurant built a fine reputation for serving fresh local food.
example.zh: 这家小餐馆因供应新鲜的本地食物而赢得了良好声誉。

example.t: This job requires good communication skills.
example.zh: 这份工作需要良好的沟通能力。

meaning_zh: 有韧性的；能迅速恢复的

example.t: Coral reefs are surprisingly resilient and can recover if the water cools again quickly.
example.zh: 珊瑚礁的恢复力出人意料地强，如果水温再次迅速下降，它们就能恢复。

example.t: The country lacks natural resources.
example.zh: 这个国家缺乏自然资源。

example.t: She responded to my email within an hour.
example.zh: 她在一小时内回复了我的邮件。

example.t: The court ordered the fraudster to pay full restitution to every one of his victims.
example.zh: 法院命令这名诈骗犯向每一位受害者全额赔偿。

example.t: The city decided to restrict traffic in the centre during busy hours.
example.zh: 该市决定在高峰时段限制市中心的交通。

example.t: The survey revealed that most young workers felt unhappy with their pay.
example.zh: 这项调查显示，大多数年轻员工对自己的薪酬感到不满。

example.t: The speech was full of rhetoric but offered no practical solutions at all.
example.zh: 这篇演讲充满修辞辞藻，却完全没有提出任何切实的解决办法。

example.t: The findings come from a rigorous study that controlled every relevant variable.
example.zh: 这些发现来自一项控制了所有相关变量的严谨研究。

example.t: The conclusion is based on robust evidence collected from several independent sources.
example.zh: 这一结论建立在从多个独立来源收集的有力证据之上。

example.t: He has only a rudimentary understanding of statistics and cannot interpret the data.
example.zh: 他对统计学只有基本的了解，无法解读这些数据。

example.t: The report summarises the salient points of the discussion in a single page.
example.zh: 报告用一页篇幅概括了讨论的要点。

example.t: Rising sea levels are slowly increasing the salinity of valuable farmland near the coast.
example.zh: 海平面上升正在缓慢增加沿海宝贵农田的盐度。

example.t: The council voted to impose tough economic sanctions on the neighbouring state.
example.zh: 该委员会投票决定对邻国实施严厉的经济制裁。

example.t: Clean drinking water is becoming scarce in many parts of the world.
example.zh: 在世界许多地方，清洁的饮用水正变得稀缺。

example.t: The new findings were met with scepticism by researchers who demanded larger and more rigorous trials.
example.zh: 这些新发现遭到了研究人员的质疑，他们要求进行更大规模、更严格的试验。

example.t: He cheated without the slightest scruple, caring nothing for the innocent people he ruined.
example.zh: 他行骗时没有丝毫顾忌，对被自己毁掉的清白之人毫不在意。

example.t: Investors now scrutinise every claim in a company's report before committing their own money.
example.zh: 投资者如今在下注前会仔细审查公司报告中的每一项说法。

example.t: The company's accounts came under close scrutiny after the sudden financial collapse.
example.zh: 公司突然财务崩溃后，其账目受到了严密审查。

example.t: A sedentary lifestyle greatly increases the risk of heart disease and other health problems.
example.zh: 久坐不动的生活方式会大大增加患心脏病和其他健康问题的风险。

example.t: Many young graduates seek advice from experienced workers before choosing a career.
example.zh: 许多年轻毕业生在选择职业前会向有经验的员工寻求建议。

example.t: Racial segregation in schools was declared illegal more than sixty years ago.
example.zh: 学校中的种族隔离在六十多年前就被宣布为非法。

example.t: The region experiences frequent seismic activity, so buildings must be built to resist earthquakes.
example.zh: 该地区地震活动频繁，因此建筑物必须能抗震。

example.t: There was a significant rise in prices.
example.zh: 物价显著上涨。

example.t: Engineers use powerful software to simulate the effects of a major earthquake on tall buildings.
example.zh: 工程师使用功能强大的软件来模拟大地震对高楼的影响。

example.t: Beneath the elegant sophistry of his speech there lay no evidence that could survive close inspection.
example.zh: 在他那番言辞精巧的诡辩之下，没有任何经得起仔细推敲的证据。

example.t: Critics argued that the new treaty would seriously weaken their country's national sovereignty.
example.zh: 批评者认为这项新条约会严重削弱他们国家的主权。

meaning_zh: 似是而非的；貌似有理的

example.t: His specious argument sounded convincing until the panel carefully examined its underlying assumptions and data.
example.zh: 他那似是而非的论点听上去很有说服力，直到评审小组仔细审查了其潜在的假设和数据。

example.t: Opinions on the issue cover a wide spectrum, from complete support to total rejection.
example.zh: 对该问题的看法涵盖很广的范围，从完全支持到彻底反对。

example.t: Historians can only speculate about the real reasons behind the sudden decision.
example.zh: 历史学家只能推测这一突然决定背后的真正原因。

meaning_zh: 虚假的；伪造的；站不住脚的

example.t: The court dismissed the document as spurious because its signature had clearly been forged.
example.zh: 法院认定该文件是伪造的而不予采信，因为其签名明显是假的。

example.t: Doctors say the patient's condition has remained stable throughout the whole night.
example.zh: 医生说病人的病情整夜保持稳定。

example.t: The council consulted every stakeholder before approving the new housing development plan.
example.zh: 市议会在批准新的住房开发计划前咨询了每一位利益相关者。

example.t: The party has taken a firm stance against any higher fuel taxes.
example.zh: 该党对任何提高燃油税的做法都采取了坚定立场。

example.t: The statistics show a steady rise in university applications over the past decade.
example.zh: 统计数据显示，过去十年大学申请人数稳步上升。

example.t: The new statute requires all large companies to publish their carbon emissions every year.
example.zh: 新法规要求所有大型公司每年公布其碳排放量。

example.t: The campaign uses humour to challenge common stereotypes about older workers and retirement.
example.zh: 该宣传活动用幽默来挑战关于年长员工和退休的常见刻板印象。

example.t: The company completely changed its marketing strategy after sales fell last year.
example.zh: 去年销量下滑后，这家公司彻底改变了营销策略。

example.t: Many daily habits are driven by subconscious impulses that we rarely pause to examine.
example.zh: 许多日常习惯由下意识的冲动驱动，我们很少停下来审视它们。

example.t: Taste in art is largely subjective and varies greatly between different people.
example.zh: 艺术品味在很大程度上是主观的，因人而异。

example.t: Advertisers often use subliminal messages that subtly influence our buying choices without conscious awareness.
example.zh: 广告商常用潜意识信息，在我们毫无察觉时微妙地影响购买选择。

example.t: The court issued a subpoena forcing the reluctant witness to appear and finally testify.
example.zh: 法院发出传票，迫使不情愿的证人出庭并最终作证。

example.t: Subsequent events proved her right.
example.zh: 后来的事件证明她是对的。

example.t: The government cut fuel subsidies, which pushed transport costs sharply higher last year.
example.zh: 政府削减了燃油补贴，导致去年运输成本大幅上升。

example.t: The author fails to substantiate her main argument with any reliable evidence.
example.zh: 作者未能用任何可靠的证据来证实她的主要论点。

example.t: There is a subtle difference between the two words in this context.
example.zh: 在这个语境中，这两个词之间存在微妙的差别。

example.t: The evidence was simply not sufficient to prove that he was guilty.
example.zh: 这些证据根本不足以证明他有罪。

meaning_zh: 肤浅的；表面的；不深入的

example.t: The essay offers only a superficial analysis of poverty and ignores its deeper structural causes.
example.zh: 这篇文章对贫困只作了肤浅的分析，忽视了其更深层的结构性原因。

example.t: Critics argued that the final chapter was entirely superfluous and weakened the novel's powerful ending.
example.zh: 批评家认为最后一章纯属多余，削弱了小说强有力的结尾。

example.t: Some people have a genetic susceptibility that makes them catch common colds more easily.
example.zh: 有些人具有遗传易感性，使他们更容易患上普通感冒。

example.t: Governments must find sustainable ways to produce food for a rapidly growing global population.
example.zh: 各国政府必须找到可持续的方式来为迅速增长的全球人口生产粮食。

example.t: Patients with this rare syndrome often suffer from extreme tiredness and constant muscle pain.
example.zh: 患有这种罕见综合征的病人常常极度疲倦，并伴有持续的肌肉疼痛。

example.t: Her book offers a brilliant synthesis of history, economics and political theory.
example.zh: 她的书精彩地综合了历史学、经济学和政治理论。

example.t: Chemists can now synthesize the active ingredient of the drug safely in large quantities.
example.zh: 化学家如今能够安全地大量合成这种药物的有效成分。

example.t: They carried out a systematic review of every study published on the topic.
example.zh: 他们对已发表的关于该主题的每一项研究进行了系统综述。

example.t: We must take into account the total cost before making a final decision.
example.zh: 在做出最终决定前，我们必须考虑到总成本。

example.t: Refusing to negotiate openly was tantamount to declaring that the bitter dispute would continue indefinitely.
example.zh: 公开拒绝谈判无异于宣布这场激烈的争端将无限期持续下去。

example.t: New tariffs raised the price of imported steel by almost a third.
example.zh: 新关税使进口钢材价格上涨了近三分之一。

example.t: Her cheerful temperament made her popular, even when the office was under great pressure.
example.zh: 即便办公室压力很大，她开朗的性情也让她很受欢迎。

example.t: Many young people have a tendency to spend too much time online.
example.zh: 许多年轻人有花太多时间上网的倾向。

example.t: Freedom of expression is a central tenet of most democratic constitutions around the world.
example.zh: 言论自由是全世界大多数民主宪法的一项核心原则。

example.t: These are only tentative conclusions, which much later research may well revise.
example.zh: 这些只是初步的结论，后续的研究很可能会加以修正。

example.t: The connection between the two events is far too tenuous to be convincing.
example.zh: 这两件事之间的关联太牵强，无法令人信服。

example.t: Terrestrial animals face very different survival challenges from those that live in the sea.
example.zh: 陆生动物面临的生存挑战与生活在海里的动物截然不同。

example.t: Her testimony in court was so consistent that the jury trusted every single word.
example.zh: 她在法庭上的证词前后一致，陪审团因此相信了每一个字。

example.t: The theory was later proved correct.
example.zh: 该理论后来被证明是正确的。

example.t: Gardening can have a therapeutic effect on people recovering from a long, serious illness.
example.zh: 园艺对从长期重病中康复的人有治疗效果。

example.t: She trained hard every single day, thereby improving her speed and strength.
example.zh: 她每天刻苦训练，从而提高了速度和力量。

example.t: Climate change now poses a serious threat to many low-lying island nations.
example.zh: 气候变化如今对许多低洼岛国构成严重威胁。

example.t: Once temperatures pass a certain threshold, the whole ecosystem begins to change.
example.zh: 一旦气温超过某个临界值，整个生态系统就开始发生变化。

example.t: The festival is celebrated throughout the whole country with music and dancing.
example.zh: 全国上下都通过音乐和舞蹈来庆祝这个节日。

example.t: The teacher would not tolerate any form of cheating in her class.
example.zh: 这位老师绝不容忍课堂上任何形式的作弊。

example.t: A tort is a civil wrong that allows the injured party to claim compensation.
example.zh: 侵权行为是一种民事过错，使受害方得以索赔。

example.t: Workers must wear protective clothing when handling highly toxic chemicals in the industrial plant.
example.zh: 工人在工厂里处理剧毒化学品时必须穿防护服。

example.t: For such a minor transgression as parking illegally, the fine seemed unusually harsh and unfair.
example.zh: 对于违章停车这样轻微的越规行为，这一罚款显得异常严厉且不公。

example.t: Voters are demanding greater transparency about how public money is actually spent.
example.zh: 选民要求提高公共资金实际使用方式的透明度。

example.t: She spent many years in therapy working through the deep trauma of the accident.
example.zh: 她花了多年接受治疗，慢慢消化那场事故带来的深层创伤。

example.t: The two rival nations eventually signed a treaty banning the testing of nuclear weapons.
example.zh: 两个敌对的国家最终签署了禁止核武器试验的条约。

example.t: There is a growing trend towards cycling.
example.zh: 骑车出行的趋势日益增长。

example.t: Rising tuition fees have discouraged many poorer students from applying to university.
