example.zh: 不断上涨的学费使许多较贫困的学生不愿申请大学。

meaning_zh: 无处不在的；普遍存在的

example.t: Smartphones have become so ubiquitous that few people can imagine daily life without them.
example.zh: 智能手机已变得如此普遍，很少有人能想象没有它们的日常生活。

example.t: Constant criticism can slowly undermine a child's confidence and love of learning.
example.zh: 不断的批评会慢慢削弱孩子的自信和对学习的热爱。

example.t: These findings underscore the urgent need for better mental health services in rural areas.
example.zh: 这些发现凸显了农村地区对更好的心理健康服务的迫切需要。

example.t: She is undoubtedly one of the best students in our whole class.
example.zh: 她无疑是我们全班最优秀的学生之一。

example.t: Youth unemployment in the region is nearly three times the national average.
example.zh: 该地区的青年失业率几乎是全国平均水平的三倍。

example.t: Testing new drugs on prisoners without consent is clearly unethical and now widely illegal.
example.zh: 未经同意在囚犯身上试验新药显然不道德，如今也普遍违法。

example.t: We will cancel the picnic unless the weather improves by early tomorrow morning.
example.zh: 除非明天一早天气好转，否则我们将取消野餐。

example.t: The pandemic caused disruption on an unprecedented scale to global supply chains and international travel.
example.zh: 这场大流行以前所未有的规模冲击了全球供应链与国际旅行。

example.t: The court upheld the ban, ruling that it clearly protected public health.
example.zh: 法院维持了该禁令，裁定它明确保护公众健康。

example.t: Rapid urbanisation has swallowed up valuable farmland and strained local water supplies.
example.zh: 快速城市化吞噬了农田，并使当地供水紧张。

example.t: As the country urbanised, millions of farmers moved into newly built cities.
example.zh: 随着这个国家城市化，数百万农民搬进了新建的城市。

example.t: Further experiments were needed to validate the results of the first study.
example.zh: 需要进一步的实验来验证第一项研究的结果。

example.t: The researchers changed one variable at a time to isolate its effect.
example.zh: 研究人员每次只改变一个变量，以单独观察其影响。

example.t: Statisticians use variance to describe how widely the data are spread around the mean.
example.zh: 统计学家用方差来描述数据在均值周围的分散程度。

example.t: The court openly questioned the veracity of a witness who had twice lied before.
example.zh: 法庭公开质疑一名曾两次说谎的证人的可信度。

example.t: After a long and tense trial, the jury returned a unanimous verdict of not guilty.
example.zh: 经过漫长而紧张的庭审，陪审团一致裁定无罪。

example.t: Journalists should always verify their sources before publishing such a serious story.
example.zh: 记者在发表如此严肃的报道前应始终核实消息来源。

example.t: Solar power has become a viable alternative to burning coal and gas.
example.zh: 太阳能已成为替代燃煤和燃气的一种可行选择。

example.t: The newspaper vilified the young activist as a troublemaker without offering any real evidence.
example.zh: 该报把这名年轻的活动人士诋毁为捣乱分子，却拿不出任何真凭实据。

example.t: The long-awaited inquiry vindicated the scientists whose warnings had been publicly dismissed for years.
example.zh: 人们期待已久的调查证明了那些科学家的正确，他们的警告多年来一直被公开忽视。

example.t: The two products are virtually identical, except for the small price tag.
example.zh: 这两个产品几乎完全相同，只是价格标签不同。

meaning_zh: 有德行的；善良的；贞洁的

example.t: He led a virtuous and simple life, always helping neighbours and never seeking reward.
example.zh: 他过着有德而简朴的生活，总是帮助邻里，从不求回报。

example.t: Vocational training gives school leavers the practical skills that employers actually need.
example.zh: 职业培训为毕业生提供雇主真正需要的实用技能。

example.t: Oil prices remain highly volatile because sudden political events can change global supply overnight.
example.zh: 油价仍然高度不稳定，因为突发的政治事件可能一夜之间改变全球供应。

example.t: Elderly people are especially vulnerable to illness during the very cold winter months.
example.zh: 老年人在极其寒冷的冬季特别容易生病。

example.t: The minimum wage was raised again to help low-paid workers with rising prices.
example.zh: 最低工资再次上调，以帮助低薪工人应对物价上涨。

example.t: The government spends a great deal of public money on child welfare.
example.zh: 政府在儿童福利上投入了大量公共资金。

example.t: Some students really enjoy group work, whereas others prefer to study alone.
example.zh: 有些学生真的很喜欢小组合作，而另一些则更喜欢独自学习。

example.t: I am still not sure whether he will agree to join our team.
example.zh: 我仍然不确定他是否会同意加入我们的团队。

example.t: There is widespread concern about the effects of social media on teens.
example.zh: 人们对社交媒体对青少年的影响普遍感到担忧。

example.t: You must hand in the full report within three working days from now.
example.zh: 你必须在从现在起三个工作日内提交完整报告。

example.t: Women now make up almost half of the country's total paid workforce.
example.zh: 女性现在几乎占全国有偿劳动力的一半。

example.t: The moon is perfectly round tonight.
example.zh: 今晚的月亮圆得完美。

example.t: Lanterns light the path to the bridge.
example.zh: 灯笼照亮了通往桥的路。

example.t: Make a wish before the lantern goes out.
example.zh: 在灯熄灭之前许个愿吧。

example.t: Cross the bridge, and the world opens up.
example.zh: 渡过那座桥，世界就打开了。

example.t: The fox mingled with the guests at the tea party.
example.zh: 狐狸混进了茶会的客人们中间。

example.t: It takes courage to sit with strangers.
example.zh: 坐到陌生人中间，是需要勇气的。

example.t: Freedom is not a wish; it is a step.
example.zh: 自由不是愿望，是脚步。

example.t: Her first lie tasted like cold tea.
example.zh: 她的第一个谎言，尝起来像一杯凉茶。

example.t: The tea is bitter tonight.
example.zh: 今晚的茶有点苦。

example.t: Behind the silver mask was a boy.
example.zh: 银色面具后面，是一个少年。

example.t: The tea ceremony begins at moonrise.
example.zh: 茶会在月亮升起时开始。

example.t: We were one guest short at the tea party.
example.zh: 茶会上还缺一位客人——就缺你。
